1CH 3:1.KJV: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
1CH 3:1.BHSA: וְאֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י דָויִ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֹֽולַד־לֹ֖ו בְּחֶבְרֹ֑ון הַבְּכֹ֣ור׀ אַמְנֹ֗ן לַאֲחִינֹ֨עַם֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔ית שֵׁנִי֙ דָּנִיֵּ֔אל לַאֲבִיגַ֖יִל הַֽכַּרְמְלִֽית׃

1CH 3:2.KJV: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
1CH 3:2.BHSA: הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ לְאַבְשָׁלֹ֣ום בֶּֽן־מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת־תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר הָרְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בֶן־חַגִּֽית׃

1CH 3:3.KJV: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
1CH 3:3.BHSA: הַחֲמִישִׁ֥י שְׁפַטְיָ֖ה לַאֲבִיטָ֑ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֥י יִתְרְעָ֖ם לְעֶגְלָ֥ה אִשְׁתֹּֽו׃

1CH 3:4.KJV: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
1CH 3:4.BHSA: שִׁשָּׁה֙ נֹֽולַד־לֹ֣ו בְחֶבְרֹ֔ון וַיִּ֨מְלָךְ־שָׁ֔ם שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשָׁלֹושׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ ס

1CH 3:5.KJV: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:
1CH 3:5.BHSA: וְאֵ֥לֶּה נוּלְּדוּ־לֹ֖ו בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑יִם שִׁ֠מְעָא וְשֹׁובָ֞ב וְנָתָ֤ן וּשְׁלֹמֹה֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לְבַת־שׁ֖וּעַ בַּת־עַמִּיאֵֽל׃

1CH 3:6.KJV: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

1CH 3:7.KJV: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

1CH 3:8.KJV: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

1CH 3:9.KJV: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
1CH 3:9.BHSA: כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד מִלְּבַ֥ד בְּֽנֵי־פִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וְתָמָ֥ר אֲחֹותָֽם׃ פ

1CH 3:10.KJV: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
1CH 3:10.BHSA: וּבֶן־שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה רְחַבְעָ֑ם אֲבִיָּ֥ה בְנֹ֛ו אָסָ֥א בְנֹ֖ו יְהֹושָׁפָ֥ט בְּנֹֽו׃

1CH 3:11.KJV: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
1CH 3:11.BHSA: יֹורָ֥ם בְּנֹ֛ו אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנֹ֖ו יֹואָ֥שׁ בְּנֹֽו׃

1CH 3:12.KJV: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
1CH 3:12.BHSA: אֲמַצְיָ֧הוּ בְנֹ֛ו עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בְנֹ֖ו יֹותָ֥ם בְּנֹֽו׃

1CH 3:13.KJV: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
1CH 3:13.BHSA: אָחָ֥ז בְּנֹ֛ו חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ בְנֹ֖ו מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנֹֽו׃

1CH 3:14.KJV: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

1CH 3:15.KJV: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
1CH 3:15.BHSA: וּבְנֵי֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ הַבְּכֹור֙ יֹוחָנָ֔ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖י יְהֹויָקִ֑ים הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ הָרְבִיעִ֖י שַׁלּֽוּם׃

1CH 3:16.KJV: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
1CH 3:16.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֖י יְהֹויָקִ֑ים יְכָנְיָ֥ה בְנֹ֖ו צִדְקִיָּ֥ה בְנֹֽו׃

1CH 3:17.KJV: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

1CH 3:18.KJV: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
1CH 3:18.BHSA: וּמַלְכִּירָ֥ם וּפְדָיָ֖ה וְשֶׁנְאַצַּ֑ר יְקַמְיָ֥ה הֹושָׁמָ֖ע וּנְדַבְיָֽה׃

1CH 3:19.KJV: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
1CH 3:19.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י פְדָיָ֔ה זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל וְשִׁמְעִ֑י וּבֶן־זְרֻבָּבֶל֙ מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם וַחֲנַנְיָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹמִ֖ית אֲחֹותָֽם׃

1CH 3:20.KJV: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
1CH 3:20.BHSA: וַחֲשֻׁבָ֡ה וָ֠אֹהֶל וּבֶרֶכְיָ֧ה וַֽחֲסַדְיָ֛ה י֥וּשַׁב חֶ֖סֶד חָמֵֽשׁ׃

1CH 3:21.KJV: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
1CH 3:21.BHSA: וּבֶן־חֲנַנְיָ֖ה פְּלַטְיָ֣ה וִישַֽׁעְיָ֑ה בְּנֵ֤י רְפָיָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַרְנָ֔ן בְּנֵ֥י עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָֽה׃ ס

1CH 3:22.KJV: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
1CH 3:22.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה שְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י שְׁמַעְיָ֗ה חַטּ֡וּשׁ וְ֠יִגְאָל וּבָרִ֧יחַ וּנְעַרְיָ֛ה וְשָׁפָ֖ט שִׁשָּֽׁה׃

1CH 3:23.KJV: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

1CH 3:24.KJV: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
1CH 3:24.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְיֹועֵינַ֗י הדיוהו וְאֶלְיָשִׁ֡יב וּפְלָיָ֡ה וְ֠עַקּוּב וְיֹוחָנָ֧ן וּדְלָיָ֛ה וַעֲנָ֖נִי שִׁבְעָֽה׃ ס

records.distinguisher: King of Judah and son of Manasseh (2KI 21:18)

records.distinguisher: King of Judah (1KI 15:9), son of incestuous relationship between Abijah and his mother, Maacah (1KI 15:10)

records.distinguisher: Son of King Jeconiah, of the royal line of Judah; not attested among given verses

records.name: Azariah
records.distinguisher: [Uzziah] King of Judah, son of Amaziah (2KI 14:21)

records.name: Bathsheba
records.distinguisher: daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah (2SA 11:3)

records.name: David
records.distinguisher: son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3)

records.name: Eliakim
records.distinguisher: King of Judah, son of Josiah (2KI 23:34)

records.distinguisher: son of David (1CH 3:6) [his OTHER son named Eliphelet]

records.name: Hezekiah
records.distinguisher: King of Judah, son of Ahaz (2KI 16:20)

records.name: Hodaviah
records.distinguisher: his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZR 2:40)

records.name: Jehoahaz
records.distinguisher: King of Judah, son of Josiah (2KI 23:30)

records.name: Jehoiachin
records.distinguisher: King of Judah, son of Eliakim [Jehoiakim] (2KI 24:6)

records.name: Jehoram
records.distinguisher: King of Judah and son of Jehoshaphat (1KI 22:50)

records.name: Jehoshaphat
records.distinguisher: son of Asa and King of Judah (1KI 15:24)

records.name: Joash
records.distinguisher: King of Judah (2KI 11:21), son of Ahaziah (2KI 11:2)

records.name: Johanan
records.distinguisher: the firstborn of Josiah, who never reigned (1CH 3:15)

records.distinguisher: prophesied son of the house of David (1KI 13:2), King of Judah and son of Amon (2KI 21:24)

records.name: Jotham
records.distinguisher: King of Judah, son of King Uzziah [Azariah] (2KI 15:30)

records.name: Maacah
records.distinguisher: daughter of Talmai, King of Geshur (2SA 3:3)

records.name: Manasseh
records.distinguisher: King of Judah and son of Hezekiah (2KI 20:21)

records.name: Mattaniah
records.distinguisher: King of Judah, uncle of Jehoiachin (2KI 24:17)

records.name: Rehoboam
records.distinguisher: son of Solomon who became king after him (1KI 11:43)

records.distinguisher: returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (EZR 2:2, NEH 7:7), son of Shealtiel (EZR 3:2)
